parent_evidence.purpose_of_new_experiment: stress-test the local-equilibrium reliability axis after the BRIDGE-01 ceiling result using structurally plausible hard decoys

scientific_question: Can local-equilibrium response distinguish a context-coherent direct mechanism from a deliberately higher-confidence, same-module, same-sign, direct-edge hard decoy whose one-step evidence and lower-order graph burden are matched?

claim_scope.allowed_if_go: Under a prospectively frozen synthetic local-regulatory generator, equilibrium response can distinguish a context-coherent direct mechanism from a higher-confidence direct-edge decoy matched on source, module, direct-edge sign and magnitude, motif degree, and absolute two-step path burden.
prohibited: real genomic loci are biological steady states
equilibrium reliability is a posterior probability
equilibrium reliability reweights or calibrates real-data PIPs
the stress test establishes direct regulatory causality in real data
the stress test proves alternative-path specificity unless the prespecified secondary endpoint supports it
the stress test validates a real-GWAS-to-equilibrium-field mapping

model.global_contraction_design: ||W||_2=0.30 so the global Lipschitz constant is <=0.30<1
model.posterior_semantics: none; R_eq is an orthogonal synthetic reliability quantity

world_generator.source_module_rule: choose one module uniformly; randomly permute its eight nodes into source,true,direct_decoy,altpath_decoy,m1,m2,m3,m4
world_generator.motif_sign_rule: draw q in {-1,+1}; source->true and source->direct_decoy both q*w_direct; source->all four mediators q*a; mediator->target signs define contextual coherence
world_generator.true_context: two reinforcing two-step paths: m1->true=+b and m2->true=+b
world_generator.hard_direct_decoy_context: one reinforcing and one cancelling two-step path with identical absolute path burden: m3->direct=+b and m4->direct=-b
world_generator.alternative_path_context: no source->altpath direct edge; m3->altpath=+b and m4->altpath=+b, giving two reinforcing two-step paths
world_generator.external_context_matching: true and hard_direct targets receive identical cross-module inbound/outbound edges and identical baseline field; their direct source edges have identical signed magnitude
world_generator.context_swap_control: flip only the second mediator sign at true and hard_direct: true becomes reinforcing/cancelling and hard_direct becomes reinforcing/reinforcing; direct source edges and matched external context remain unchanged

candidate_mechanisms.true: same source; context-coherent direct target; claimed sign=sign(delta*W[true,source])
candidate_mechanisms.hard_direct: same source and module; direct edge has exactly the same signed magnitude as true; same claimed sign; same motif degree and absolute two-step path burden, but one two-step path cancels
candidate_mechanisms.alternative_path: same source and module; no direct source edge; two reinforcing two-step paths; same claimed sign; specificity-boundary control
candidate_mechanisms.wrong_sign: true source and true target with the claimed sign reversed

confidence_stress_test.interpretation: adversarial synthetic confidence ordering; not calibrated probability
confidence_stress_test.purpose: ensure confidence alone prefers both hard decoys to the context-coherent true mechanism

primary_endpoints.context_swap_reversal_fraction: fraction of worlds in which matched graph ranks true>hard_direct and the context-swap graph ranks hard_direct>true

secondary_endpoints.alternative_path: R_eq(true)-R_eq(alternative_path); reported as a specificity-boundary result and cannot rescue a failed primary gate

alternative_path_interpretation.supported: true-over-altpath win fraction >=0.65 and Wilson lower >0.50
alternative_path_interpretation.ambiguous: true-over-altpath win fraction between 0.35 and 0.65 inclusive, or CI crosses 0.50

secondary_endpoints.residual_and_rho: max and distribution of residuals/effective spectral radii

hard_preconditions: exactly 128 worlds generated with unique world_id and no post-hoc exclusion
all role nodes are distinct and true/hard_direct/alternative_path are in the source module
true and hard_direct direct edges have identical signed magnitude within 1e-12 after scaling
true and hard_direct have equal motif in-degree and equal absolute two-step path burden by construction
alternative_path has no direct source edge
all matched and context-swap baseline/perturbed solves are admissible
frozen contract/runner/launcher hashes match the freeze manifest
go_requires_all: Wilson 95% lower bound for hard_direct win fraction >0.50
95% bootstrap lower bound for median Delta_direct >0
Wilson 95% lower bound for context-swap reversal fraction >0.50
